description: Check a PUBLIC message signature: EIP-191 personal_sign (0x address, 65-byte hex sig) or Bitcoin Core signmessage (P2PKH address, base64 sig). message_is_hex=true when the message is hex bytes. Returns status ok or signer_mismatch, chain, address and the recovered signer. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: msg_verify
title: Verify a signed message (dev tool)
